title: Get recommended hashtags for TikTok accounts
content_data:
Use this endpoint to specify a keyword and get a list of recommended hashtags to be used for your TikTok account videos. The returned hashtag (`name`) can be used in the `caption` field as part of the video caption when you publish a video to your TikTok account via [/business/video/publish/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228496095234). This is a new endpoint in version 1.3. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/hashtag/suggestion/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}| Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string |Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.
Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | keyword {Required} | string | The keyword that you want to get recommended hashtags for. | | language | string | Keyword language. The language of the hashtag recommendations will match the keyword language.

Default value: `en` (English).

Enum values:
  • `en`: English
  • `ar`: Arabic
  • `bn-IN`: Bengali
  • `ceb-PH`: Cebuano
  • `cs-CZ`: Czech
  • `de-DE`: German
  • `el-GR`: Greek
  • `es`: Spanish
  • `fi-FI`: Finnish
  • `fil-PH`: Filipino
  • `fr`: French
  • `he-IL`: Hebrew
  • `hi-IN`: Hindi
  • `hu-HU`: Hungarian
  • `id-ID`: Indonesian
  • `it-IT`: Italian
  • `ja-JP`: Japanese
  • `jv-ID`: Javanese
  • `km-KH`: Khmer
  • `ko-KR`: Korean
  • `ms-MY`: Malay
  • `my-MM`: Burmese
  • `nl-NL`: Dutch
  • `pl-PL`: Polish
  • `pt-BR`: Portuguese
  • `ro-RO`: Romanian
  • `ru-RU`: Russian
  • `sv-SE`: Swedish
  • `th-TH`: Thai
  • `tr-TR`: Turkish
  • `uk-UA`: Ukranian
  • `ur`: Urdu
  • `vi-VN`: Vietnamese
  • `zh-Hans`: Chinese (simplified)
  • `zh-Hant-TW`: Chinese (traditional)
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/hashtag/suggestion/?business_id={{business_id}}&keyword=summer&language=en' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response **Header** These are important headers to record for issue reports and troubleshooting. This is not an exhaustive list of response headers. ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | Date | string | Date and time (GMT) when the response was received.
Example: Fri, 13 Aug 2021 08:04:42 GMT | | X-Tt-Logid | string | Unique identifier for the API request. | ``` **Body** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| | request_id | string | Unique identifier for the API request.

Please record this field for all API requests. Important for issue reports and troubleshooting. | | code | Integer | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message| string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | data | object | Returned data. | #|suggestions| object[] | List of hashtag suggestions. 10 recommended hashtags will be provided in total and the hashtags are first ordered by exact match and then by the number of posts.

Note: If no hashtag suggestion is available for the `keyword` you specify, we will return the same keyword in `name`, and `post_count` will be 0.| ##|name | string | The name of the recommended hashtag. | ##|view_count {-To-be-deprecated} | integer | The number of views that the recommended hashtag has received.

Note: This field will be deprecated by October 9th, 2026.| ##|post_count|integer|The total number of posts that have used the recommended hashtag.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "suggestions": [ { "name": "summer", "post_count": 65296335, "view_count": 570706039722 }, { "name": "summervibes", "post_count": 8, "view_count": 61002 }, { "name": "summertime", "post_count": 4787632, "view_count": 31235450501 }, { "name": "summeroutfit", "post_count": 2245117, "view_count": 22769671766 }, { "name": "summer2020", "post_count": 1406418, "view_count": 12067892733 }, { "name": "summermashup", "post_count": 1480691, "view_count": 13305649404 }, { "name": "summerlooks", "post_count": 1479380, "view_count": 12540355600 }, { "name": "summerfashion", "post_count": 1471856, "view_count": 16047670920 }, { "name": "summer2022", "post_count": 594110, "view_count": 6387041434 }, { "name": "summernails", "post_count": 998420, "view_count": 12982293125 } ] } } (/code) ```
